label: styleOnlyStepUploadsNothing: the resident layer is uploaded again on every step
find: if let resident, resident.content == content { return resident.surface }
replace: if let resident, resident.content == content, false { return resident.surface }

label: throwingDrawShowsTheLayerUnstyled: a throwing draw hides the layer
noStyleSkipsTheDraw: an empty style still runs the draw
find: guard let style, style != .none else { return .unstyled(layer) }

label: styledResultIsCutToTheLayerWindow: the window sits at the padded result's top-left
find: return (x: max((styled.0 - width) / 2, 0), y: max((styled.1 - height) / 2, 0), width: width, height: height)
replace: return (x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height)
